items.title: Arthur "Monk" Hazel Interview, 1959-07-16
items.q: I met Emmett Hardy, I went to school with, with Emmett, you see, and we formed a little band around Gretton

ctx.x: Speaking of Tom Brown, when was the first time you heard him or his band?

Tom, well, no, when, when, when I started, Tom was away. I didn't meet Tom till, till he came back to New Orleans, and the first time I played with Tom was with Brownlee's band, out at the old Spanish fort, and, and then, while I was, I think it was a couple of years after or before that, I was working with Abby Burns out at the halfway house, when his brother Theodore came down here, with a bunch of guys from Chicago, Murphy Steinberg, and, uh, was it Polo, Polo, Clarinet player, Danny Polo, Danny Polo,…
How old is Hardy? Was he older than you, or?
